errors.text_span: 每个饼图均包含七个类别
errors.evidence: The figure and reference show eight categories/slices in each pie chart, not seven.

errors.text_span: 在图(a)滑动窗口方法中，预测为空的错误占比最高，为37%，其次是预测过短（18%）、预测过长（17%）和下一个层级（16%）
errors.evidence: In chart (a), the values are 37% for 预测为空, 18% for 预测过长, 16% for 预测过短, and 17% for 下一层级; the machine description swaps the 17% and 16% values for 预测过长 and 预测过短.
The reference label is "下一层级", not "下一个层级". This is a wrong category label.

errors.text_span: 其余类别如下一个层级、上一层级、超出NTC和其它的占比分别为8%、6%、6%和6%。
errors.evidence: In chart (b), the remaining categories are 下一层级 6%, 上一层级 9%, 超出NTC 6%, and 其他 6%; the description incorrectly gives 8% for 下一层级 and 6% for 上一层级.
The label should be "下一层级" as shown in the figure/reference, not "下一个层级".
The figure/reference use "其他" rather than "其它"; this is a label mismatch, though the meaning is clear.
The reference notes that the slices are ordered without obvious visual emphasis; the machine description does not mention this visual feature.
